data.narrative:
Kestrel operates in the Defense & Security sector alongside a fragmented peer universe of 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. The company's stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, limiting precision in peer-median analysis.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable here. Of 26 same-sector peers identified, none satisfy narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier), yielding fewer than the three datapoints required for meaningful median calibration. A fallback to all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise, as Defense & Security spans highly heterogeneous business models, geographies, and maturity stages. The fragmentation—particularly the lack of narrow-stage private comps—reflects the frontier nature of this sector and Kestrel's position within it.

Without sufficient same-stage peer data, traditional relative valuation approaches cannot be responsibly applied. A complete valuation assessment would require either (1) alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis with disclosed financial projections, (2) resolution of the stage and prior funding details to enable re-filtering of the peer set, or (3) expansion of comparable depth through non-public market intelligence. The current dataset does not support a quantified valuation range.
